sources.title: F20 official PDF manual, English printed pages 02, 03, 07 and 08
sources.method: Direct HTTP 200, SHA256 e85de3d6be80659ea27e8079af125124806877ba3a414522b647b6fe04368919; English extracted text read; physical PDF pages 5 and 9 rendered and visually checked
facts: Three AAA backup batteries are not included. With backup battery power after mains loss, pre-set feeding continues; cooling and warming pause; app indicates offline (printed page 03).
Only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi supported, not 5GHz. No verified battery runtime, Wi-Fi-only outage behavior or remote-operation guarantee is supplied here.
Flat surface and unobstructed side ventilation are required. Manual warns against carpets, especially shag carpets.
Fresh food should not be stored beyond 24 hours per manual; this upper limit is not a guaranteed safe period for all foods or after loss of cooling.
Cleaning requires disconnecting mains and removing backup batteries; tray can be rinsed and dried, main unit must not be rinsed.

sources.title: Cats Protection: Introducing cats and managing competition
sources.method: Direct HTTP 200 and relevant text read, also web reader
facts: Access to hallways, doorways and litter trays can be blocked. Separate locations for essential resources and one per cat plus an extra are advised to reduce competition.

sources.title: Cats Protection: Cats and play
sources.method: Direct HTTP 200, relevant text read, also web reader
facts: Short play sessions can be useful. Allow periodic catches; rotate toys, inspect wear and do not leave entanglement or ingestion hazards unattended. Avoid using hands or feet as toys.

sources.title: Battersea: Playing with your cat
sources.method: Direct HTTP 200, relevant text read, also web reader
facts: Wand toys can permit stalking, chasing and catching at a distance from hands. Suggests prey-like movement with pauses, different toy preferences and supervised use of string toys.

sources.title: FDA: Tips for safe handling of pet food and treats
sources.method: Web reader, snapshot marked crawled today
facts: Promptly refrigerate or discard unused or leftover canned and pouched pet food; wash food bowls and utensils after each use. This is general handling guidance, not F20 validation.
